malaysia.title: Flag of Malaysia (Jalur Gemilang)

colors.note: Represents the colour of the Malay rulers

desc: - Fourteen alternating red and white horizontal stripes with a blue canton bearing a yellow crescent and 14-point Federal Star
- Known as the Jalur Gemilang (Stripes of Glory)
trivia:
- The 14 stripes represent the 13 states and the federal territories (14 equal entities)
- The yellow crescent and star represent Islam and the monarchy
- Malaysia's flag emphasizes both Islamic faith and democratic federalism
